headline: DSWD Mobilizes Aid in Zamboanga, Urges Public to Stop Sharing Shooting Videos
seoTitle: DSWD Deploys Aid in Zamboanga, Urges Halt to Video Sharing | FMB News
seoDescription: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian led aid and psychosocial support efforts in Zamboanga and appealed to the public to stop circulating campus shooting footage.
deck: Social workers and child-support teams are assisting the school community while officials warn that recirculating violent footage can retraumatize survivors.
author: FMB News Desk

sections.heading: What happened
paragraphs: Social Welfare Secretary Rex Gatchalian led DSWD aid and trauma-support operations in Zamboanga City on Thursday following the deadly campus shooting, according to the approved FMB News evening package.

The department also appealed to the public to stop circulating violent footage of the incident, warning that repeated sharing can deepen trauma for students, families and other members of the school community.

sections.heading: Context
paragraphs: The package says DSWD assistance includes emergency financial support under its assistance programs as well as psychosocial services delivered by social workers and child-support specialists.
A specialized DSWD team is expected to remain in Zamboanga to continue socio-emotional support for affected members of the school community.

sections.heading: Why this matters
paragraphs: Beyond immediate financial assistance, post-trauma support can be critical after school violence. Limiting the spread of graphic material also protects the privacy and dignity of minors and reduces the risk of retraumatization.

sections.heading: What to watch next
paragraphs: Watch for continued DSWD and local-government counseling programs, additional assistance for affected families, and guidance from child-protection and cyber-safety agencies on handling violent online content.
